falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug would be broken, as that bottom formation held above 5,100; a drop to 4,800 would indicate a much deeper correction than the August 2024 structure, invalidating the bottoming pattern thesis and suggesting continuation lower rather than stabilization

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX spike to ~38 but rapidly mean-revert; sustained elevation above 35 would indicate persistent panic rather than a washout/capitulation event, breaking the pattern of rapid volatility compression that characterized the 2024 bottom and suggesting the current structure is a bear market continuation, not a tradable low

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further to -50bps or wider (more negative than -0.50%)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with yield curve steepening from deeply inverted levels as recession fears peaked and reversed; further inversion to -50bps would indicate worsening growth expectations and financial conditions tightening, directly contradicting the 2024 bottom pattern where curve steepening signaled economic optimism returning and would invalidate the macro stabilization thesis underlying the HOLD signal
